🔧 增强多样性总结

Background Styles

  • Concrete (混凝土)
  • Metal Floor (金属地板)
  • Workshop (车间)
  • Conveyor (传送带)
  • Gradient (渐变)
  • Noise (噪声)
  • Textured (纹理)

Photometric Changes

  • Brightness (亮度 0.5-1.5x)
  • Contrast (对比度 0.7-1.3x)
  • Gamma Correction (伽马 0.6-1.8)
  • Hue Shift (色调偏移)
  • Shadow (阴影)
  • Highlight (高光)
  • Color Temperature (色温)

Depth Noise

  • Gaussian Noise (高斯噪声 1-5mm)
  • Quantization (量化 1/2/5mm)
  • Hole Simulation (空洞 0.5-3%)
  • Flying Pixels (飞点)
  • Edge Dilation (边缘膨胀 1-3px)
  • Multipath Interference (多径干扰)
